newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-DUNHILL CUP CONFIRMED FOR THREE MORE YEARS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-DUNHILL CUP CONFIRMED FOR THREE MORE YEARS.

text.p: The Alfred Dunhill Cup international golf team event will continue at St Andrews for the next three years, the sponsors said on Sunday.
The announcement was made as the 12th edition of the event was being concluded over the Old Course.
The present contract with the sponsors, a men's luxury goods company, concluded this year and there had been fears the competition could be discontinued.
Bad weather at past events at the tournament's regular October date was believed to have upset the sponsors, who were seeking an earlier date.
But warm weather this week and the likelihood that an earlier date could be secured after next year were believed to have swayed the sponsors to continue to back the popular tournament.
"I look forward to welcoming all those involved with this wonderful championship back to the Home of Golf next October," chairman Richard Dunhill said.
